cases.explanation: The same event and stage are joined with a comma instead of the reference slash. All facts and file-title assignments agree. Strict invented_info is a string-difference proxy, not evidence of fabrication.

findings.got: same event and stage joined by comma

cases.explanation: The source explicitly speculates that its named venue may denote another venue. The parser carries that qualifier into the venue tag but marks the album ready. This is missed review under the frozen conservative policy, not an invented alternate venue or wrong track assignment.

findings.expected: reported venue only, with review required
findings.got: reported venue plus speculative alternate; ready

cases.explanation: The line identifying the combined performers alternate name is prepended to the venue. It describes the act, not the theatre. All51 file-title mappings agree.

findings.got: performer alias followed by The Capitol Theatre

cases.explanation: Track6 is explicitly described as an uncertain new-song title; it must remain unresolved for automatic tagging. The parser accepts it and marks ready. It also assigns the hall name to city. Retaining the artist affiliation is harmless decoration; omitting hall from venue alone is a granularity difference, but putting the hall in city is an incorrect field assignment.

findings.expected: unknown mapping until title is resolved
findings.got: track6 mapped to provisional source title
solo artist name plus band affiliation

cases.explanation: All12 numeric file-to-track identifiers and song names are aligned correctly. The12 strict mapping failures arise solely from bracketed durations retained in title strings; they are unwanted title decoration, not wrong-song assignment. Separately the event name is assigned to city despite an explicit municipality/state line, a material metadata error.

findings.got: same12 song titles and IDs with bracketed durations

limitations: These five cases were selected from accepted nonexact outputs, not a random independent sample. Material issue classification is a source-informed agent audit by a reference author, not human certification. Counts distinguish metadata/tag-quality errors from wrong-file song assignment and must not be described as13 wrong-song mappings.
scope: Postfreeze source audit of every eligible baseline validated-ready nonexact output, plus status of disputed references. Primary gold and scores unchanged.

sensitivity_only.description: Posthoc interpretation, not replacement scoring: accepting comma/slash joining for the one event-stage case would increase baseline exact from8 to9 of197. Ignoring trailing bracketed durations would reduce strict accepted mapping differences from13 to1; the Kung Fu album remains nonexact because its city is wrong.
